entities.summary: Dewan Antonio Hernandez is an American professional basketball player for Busan KCC Egis of the Korean Basketball League (KBL). He played college basketball for the Miami Hurricanes, and briefly played for the Toronto Raptors in the National Basketball Association (NBA).
